    f_i = {item: 0.0 for item in I}
    for (idx, row) in fee_df.iterrows():
        item = row['item_ref']
        if item in I:
            f_i[item] = float(row['activation_fee_cents'])
    u_ir = {(item, res): 0.0 for item in I for res in R}
    for (idx, row) in usage_df.iterrows():
        item = row['item_ref']
        res = row['resource']
        if item not in I or res not in R:
            continue
        amt = float(row['amount'])
        unit = row['unit']
        if unit.casefold() == 'gb':
            amt = amt * 1000.0
        u_ir[item, res] = amt
    C_r = {res: 0.0 for res in R}
    for (idx, row) in res_df.iterrows():
        res = row['resource']
        amt = float(row['amount'])
        unit = row['unit']
        if unit.casefold() == 'gb':
            amt = amt * 1000.0
        C_r[res] += amt
    B = []
    q_ij = {}
    for (idx, row) in bundle_df.iterrows():
        i = row['item_a']
        j = row['item_b']
        if i not in I or j not in I:
            continue
        B.append((i, j))
        q_ij[i, j] = float(row['bonus_cents'])
    E = []
    for (idx, row) in incomp_df.iterrows():
        i = row['item_a']
        j = row['item_b']
        if i not in I or j not in I:
            continue
        if i < j:
            E.append((i, j))
        else:
            E.append((j, i))
    Q = []
    for (idx, row) in req_df.iterrows():
        i = row['item_ref']
        pr = row['prerequisite_ref']
        if i not in I or pr not in I:
            continue
        Q.append((i, pr))
    items_in_cat = {g: [] for g in G}
    for item in I:
        g = g_i[item]
        items_in_cat[g].append(item)
    m = gp.Model('GameEditionAllocation')
    m.Params.MIPGap = 0.0001
    x_vars = {}
    y_vars = {}
    for item in I:
        if a_i[item] == 0:
            x_vars[item] = m.addVar(lb=0, ub=0, vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, name=f'x_{item}')
            y_vars[item] = m.addVar(lb=0, ub=0, vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name=f'y_{item}')
        else:
            x_vars[item] = m.addVar(lb=0, ub=u_i[item], vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, name=f'x_{item}')
            y_vars[item] = m.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name=f'y_{item}')
    z_vars = {}
    for g in G:
        z_vars[g] = m.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name=f'z_{g}')
    w_vars = {}
    for (i, j) in B:
        w_vars[i, j] = m.addVar(vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name=f'w_{i}_{j}')
    m.update()
    for item in I:
        if a_i[item] == 0:
            m.addConstr(x_vars[item] == 0, name=f'x_zero_{item}')
            m.addConstr(y_vars[item] == 0, name=f'y_zero_{item}')
        else:
            m.addConstr(x_vars[item] >= l_i[item] * y_vars[item], name=f'x_minlot_{item}')
            m.addConstr(x_vars[item] <= u_i[item] * y_vars[item], name=f'x_maxorder_{item}')
    for item in I:
        if a_i[item] == 1:
            m.addConstr(y_vars[item] >= x_vars[item] / u_i[item], name=f'y_lb_{item}')
            m.addConstr(y_vars[item] <= x_vars[item] / l_i[item], name=f'y_ub_{item}')
    for res in R:
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((u_ir[item, res] * x_vars[item] for item in I)) <= C_r[res], name=f'rescap_{res}')
    for g in G:
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((x_vars[item] for item in items_in_cat[g])) >= L_g[g], name=f'cat_min_{g}')
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((x_vars[item] for item in items_in_cat[g])) <= U_g[g], name=f'cat_max_{g}')
        for item in items_in_cat[g]:
            m.addConstr(z_vars[g] >= y_vars[item], name=f'catact_{g}_{item}')
    for (i, j) in E:
        m.addConstr(y_vars[i] + y_vars[j] <= 1, name=f'incomp_{i}_{j}')
    for (i, pr) in Q:
        m.addConstr(y_vars[i] <= y_vars[pr], name=f'requires_{i}_{pr}')
    for (i, j) in B:
        m.addConstr(w_vars[i, j] <= y_vars[i], name=f'w_le_y_{i}_{j}')
        m.addConstr(w_vars[i, j] <= y_vars[j], name=f'w_le_y_{j}_{i}')
        m.addConstr(w_vars[i, j] >= y_vars[i] + y_vars[j] - 1, name=f'w_ge_sum_{i}_{j}')
    obj = gp.quicksum((b_i[item] * x_vars[item] - f_i[item] * y_vars[item] for item in I)) + gp.quicksum((q_ij[i, j] * w_vars[i, j] for (i, j) in B)) - gp.quicksum((F_g[g] * z_vars[g] for g in G))
    m.setObjective(obj, gp.GRB.MAXIMIZE)
    m.optimize()
    return m
